Both modes use the matched leaf depth variant by default; experiment compiles bounded opaque visible stock caster variants. CPU timings nested and not display latency. Settled canvas pixel comparisons after actual native input. High DPI Chromium device metrics override and WEBGL_lose_context simulation, not physical monitor or Windows validation.
